source: Anthropic study of ~300 AI deployments at 58 US companies, reported Nov 25 2026 (The Decoder via Dev News Digest)

scenes.title: 1 in 5 office AI projects [[gave no value]]
scenes.tamil: 5-ல ஒரு AI project எந்த பலனும் தரல!
scenes.say: A new study found that about one in five company AI projects gave no business value.

scenes.tamil: பெரிய பிரச்சனை: AI output-ஐ check பண்ண ஆள் இல்ல
scenes.say: Fifty five percent improved work. The big problem was too much AI output for people to review.

scenes.en: Plan who checks the AI output
